thread:
elaine: Heads-up: small style sync - we have `model` vs `model_name` scattered in snippets and "latency" used inconsistently. Propose: Use `model` in public SDK examples, keep `model_name` for schema/db docs, and use "response latency" when referring to end-to-end metrics.

kyle: +1 to `model`. I'll update JS/Py samples and add a brief note in examples/README.

priya: Please avoid using "deprecated" in examples until we have a formal deprecation schedule. Use "legacy" for now.

docs-bot: New PR opened by kyle: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/5077 - "examples: unify model param"

kyle: Added inline comments noting legacy schemas accept `model_name` and a tiny docs-lint to catch mixed names.

priya: I'll sweep observability pages to change ambiguous "latency" -> "response latency" where applicable.

elaine: Two action items: kyle opens examples PR, priya updates observability. Toni will add a one-line glossary entry. Merge when owners sign off; I'll post a short note in #release-notes.

docs-bot: PR 5077 CI passed ✅

kyle: Merged PR 5077 at 2462005578

elaine: Added checklist item to docs style guide: "verify SDK param parity in examples before merge". Thanks all. :rocket:
